purpose: Turn each completed research wave into the STATE for the next evidence-driven cast until the Reader Edition purpose is sufficient.
loop: RETURN -> COMPRESS -> INSPECT -> IDENTIFY REMAINING/NEW HOLES -> DEDUPLICATE -> SHRED -> CAST NEXT WAVE -> VERIFY -> REPEAT UNTIL SUFFICIENT
rules: Do not simply repeat the previous 30 questions.
Completed VERIFIED_READER_AID and NO_MATERIAL_AID jobs are closed and unavailable to later casts unless new contradictory evidence reopens them.
RECAST jobs keep the same parent job_id and name the missing evidence; child parcels may be created for materially different missing functions.
New questions may arise from contradictions, unexplained references, reader-friction holes, failed fit tests, uncovered dependencies, or newly exposed sections of the book.
Before dispatch, compare every proposed job against READY, CLAIMED, IN_PROGRESS, VERIFIED_READER_AID, NO_MATERIAL_AID, and RECAST records to prevent duplication.
Use the Full Policy Bridge Search and Fisherman's Net / Sufficiency Loop for every wave.
Prefer up to 30 useful independent jobs per wave; fewer is correct when fewer genuine holes exist.
The purpose defines sufficiency. Stop generating research jobs when remaining uncertainty would not materially improve the Reader Edition.
Preserve job lineage: wave_id, parent_job_id where applicable, paragraph_id, function_class, evidence doors, outcome, and warehouse receipt.
next_wave_trigger: A prior wave has enough returned/verified evidence to expose the next useful unresolved holes.
